points.name: Renge Onsen outdoor pools
points.ja: 蓮華温泉 野天風呂
points.season: Lodge and pools open about mid-July to late October.
points.access: The road in is closed outside summer, so the rest of the year it's a long tour in.
points.note: Four rock pools on the slope above the lodge: Ogon-yu, Senki-no-yu, Yakushi-yu and Sangokuichi-no-yu. No changing rooms. About ¥500 for the outdoor pools only.

points.name: Hakuba Yari Onsen
points.season: Early July to late September only.
points.access: 4 to 5 hours' hike up from Sarukura.
points.note: Open-air pools at about 2,100 m beside the hut. The hut is taken down every autumn because the site sits in an avalanche path all winter.
